sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role permission_ur join sys_role permission_role on permission_role.role_id = permission_ur.role_id join sys_role_menu permission_rm on permission_rm.role_id = permission_role.role_id join sys_menu permission_menu on permission_menu.menu_id = permission_rm.menu_id where permission_ur.user_id = u.user_id and permission_role.del_flag = '0' and permission_role.status = '0' and permission_menu.status = '0' and permission_menu.perms = #{permission} )

select distinct u.user_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nick_name), ''), nullif(trim(u.user_name), ''), '姓名未配置') user_name, u.dept_id, user_dept.dept_name, p.post_sort from sys_user u join sys_user_post up on up.user_id = u.user_id join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id join sys_dept anchor on anchor.dept_id = #{anchorDeptId} left join sys_dept user_dept on user_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_user_profile profile on profile.user_id = u.user_id where and p.status = '0' and p.post_code = #{postCode} and anchor.del_flag = '0' and anchor.status = '0'
and ( u.dept_id = anchor.dept_id or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_shop direct_scope where direct_scope.user_id = u.user_id and direct_scope.dept_id = anchor.dept_id ) )
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_shop responsibility_scope join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = responsibility_scope.dept_id where responsibility_scope.user_id = u.user_id and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and (scope_dept.dept_id = anchor.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, anchor.ancestors)) )
order by p.post_sort, u.user_id

select distinct u.user_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nick_name), ''), nullif(trim(u.user_name), ''), '姓名未配置') user_name, u.dept_id, user_dept.dept_name, null post_sort from sys_user u join sys_user_shop us on us.user_id = u.user_id join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id join sys_dept anchor on anchor.dept_id = #{anchorDeptId} left join sys_dept user_dept on user_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_user_profile profile on profile.user_id = u.user_id where and anchor.del_flag = '0' and anchor.status = '0' and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and (scope_dept.dept_id = anchor.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, anchor.ancestors))
order by u.user_id

select u.user_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nick_name), ''), nullif(trim(u.user_name), ''), '姓名未配置') user_name, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, null post_sort from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_user_profile profile on profile.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and

select d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_type from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0'
and d.dept_type = 'STORE'
and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'WAREHOUSE')
and d.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE')
and d.dept_id = #{scopeId}
and (d.dept_id = #{scopeId} or find_in_set(#{scopeId}, d.ancestors))
order by d.dept_id
select dept_id, dept_name, dept_type from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select min(post_sort) from sys_post where post_code = #{postCode} and status = '0'

select distinct u.user_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nick_name), ''), nullif(trim(u.user_name), ''), '姓名未配置') user_name, u.dept_id, user_dept.dept_name, p.post_sort from sys_user u join sys_user_post up on up.user_id = u.user_id join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id join sys_dept anchor on anchor.dept_id = #{anchorDeptId} left join sys_dept user_dept on user_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_user_profile profile on profile.user_id = u.user_id where and p.status = '0' and p.post_code = #{postCode} and anchor.del_flag = '0' and anchor.status = '0' and anchor.dept_type = 'STORE' and (u.dept_id = anchor.dept_id or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_shop direct_scope where direct_scope.user_id = u.user_id and direct_scope.dept_id = anchor.dept_id))
order by u.user_id

select distinct u.user_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(u.nick_name), ''), nullif(trim(u.user_name), ''), '姓名未配置') user_name, u.dept_id, user_dept.dept_name, p.post_sort from sys_user u join sys_user_post up on up.user_id = u.user_id join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id join sys_user_shop us on us.user_id = u.user_id join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id join sys_dept anchor on anchor.dept_id = #{anchorDeptId} left join sys_dept user_dept on user_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_user_profile profile on profile.user_id = u.user_id where and p.status = '0' and p.post_code = #{postCode} and anchor.del_flag = '0' and anchor.status = '0' and anchor.dept_type = 'STORE' and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and (scope_dept.dept_id = anchor.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, anchor.ancestors))
order by u.user_id
select p.post_code from sys_user_post up join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id where up.user_id = #{userId} and p.status = '0' order by p.post_sort, p.post_id
